Legend at upper right: blue circle aPTT, orange square FVIII, green triangle FVIII inhibitor. The blue aPTT line starts at the top of the axis on days 1 and 2 beside the note (Over 200 seconds), drops to about 120 on day 3, then declines gradually, ending at the printed value 66 on day 23. The green FVIII inhibitor line starts at the printed 124 on day 1 and ends at the printed 52 on day 23, with intermediate markers near days 7 and 16. The orange FVIII line starts at zero with the note (Not Detectable), rises to about 20 around day 16 and ends at the printed 4.4 on day 23. Lower section: three rows of grey dose bars labelled PSL (mg/day) with 65, 55 and 45; CPA (mg/day) with 50 and 100; aPCC (Units/day) with 5000, 6000 and 5000.
